title: Bread at the Night Market
story: The night market opened at dusk, and Amira’s stall sold warm flatbread with a herb sauce her aunt had taught her. She reduced the salt after regular customers said last week’s batch was too sharp. A tray of samples let people taste the milder version before they ordered. By the time the square filled, the first batch was already gone.

vocabulary.definition: The time in the evening when daylight fades.
A thin, flat kind of bread.
Strong and slightly harsh in taste.
Small amounts offered so people can try something.
A quantity made at the same time.

quiz.question: Who had taught Amira to make the sauce?
options: Her aunt
A regular customer
A cook in the square
The owner of the next stall
quiz.explanation: The herb sauce was one her aunt had taught her.
quiz.supportingSentence: The night market opened at dusk, and Amira’s stall sold warm flatbread with a herb sauce her aunt had taught her.

quiz.question: Why did Amira change the amount of salt?
options: Customers had found the earlier bread too strong
The market was opening after dusk
Her aunt had asked her to close
The square stayed empty all evening
quiz.correctAnswer: Customers had found the earlier bread too strong
quiz.explanation: Regular customers said the last batch was too sharp, so she reduced the salt.
quiz.supportingSentence: She reduced the salt after regular customers said last week’s batch was too sharp.

quiz.question: What does the missing first batch suggest?
options: People bought the new bread quickly
Nobody stopped to taste a sample
She added more salt during the evening
The market failed to open
quiz.correctAnswer: People bought the new bread quickly
quiz.explanation: The first batch was already gone by the time the square filled, which shows it sold fast.
quiz.supportingSentence: By the time the square filled, the first batch was already gone.

quiz.question: What does batch mean in this story?
options: A quantity made at one time
A person who buys food often
The square where a market is held
A tray used only for tasting
quiz.correctAnswer: A quantity made at one time
quiz.explanation: Last week’s batch is one lot of bread she had made, and the first batch is another lot.
quiz.supportingSentence: She reduced the salt after regular customers said last week’s batch was too sharp.

quiz.question: Why did Amira put samples on a tray?
options: So people could taste the milder bread before buying
So she could increase the salt again
So her aunt could cook in the square
So the first batch would remain unsold
quiz.correctAnswer: So people could taste the milder bread before buying
quiz.explanation: The samples let people taste the milder version before they ordered.
quiz.supportingSentence: A tray of samples let people taste the milder version before they ordered.
